Unnecessarily awkward to use, it's the worst photo app I've ever had to use.

Ok, so you´ve got all the fancy new functions, photoalbums, Assistent and bla bla.. but it got too clever, too far, too automatic, too prone to human arbitration. The app doesn´t allow you to for example manually change order of photos.  Few really disturbing things:  1) Why the heck when you make an album (upload from PC, photos in the PC are put in PC from phone by cable) are the photos chaotically disordered? They are not in the order of how you took them, they are mixed.  Google Photos reads wrong data info of the photos from computer.. Not when created (took), but when last edited.   2) Even worse (!), you can´t manually change the order. You can just go from the oldest, of from the youngest. That´s the problem. The app (or Google, or developers of the app) thing, that they are smarter than you. So they ban the option to manually change order of any photos in any album. In the end, totally useless, anger producing.

Edited 14/06/22: I read the article and did what it suggested. It has made no difference. I removed a star because the suggestion to do all those things to an app that's been working fine annoyed me. Edit 13/06/2022: crashes every time I swipe up on a photo to add to an album. In recent updates, I have noticed a lot of bugs. I rely so heavily on Google Photos (I was previously a Picasa user), and would love this to be fixed asap. Does what is expected of it and is easy to use.

Google Photos started off as an excellent app for backing up my photos. But in the last month, I have been experiencing issues with trying to backup my selected photos on to the cloud with no success. I pay £2.99 a month for extra storage, but GP still won't backup my photos. I have become very frustrated with the app, and so I have decided to reduce it from 5 stars, to 3 stars.

Photos have suddenly gone missing from the photos tab on pixel 7 pro after the last update. Update: No longer an issue as it turns out that I was logged into a different account. But I am giving a 4 star review still as I still see some pics only in one of the accounts, although the backup is turned off completely on all the accounts. Also pls give an option to save edits on the same pic (with an option to rollback the edits), instead of always having to save changes into a separate pic.

It's a pain to alter files. Rename a file? Good luck. Taking a photo of a receipt, and you want to crop it, rotate it, rename it, and send it? Those options are sometimes presented to you as a blue pop-up offering those types of options, other times not offered. Sometimes when you save your adjusted image, it seems to overwrite the file, sometimes it saves a copy in a mystery location in another folder elsewhere. Its really inconsistent.

This app is pretty good. Definitely, recommend it to friends and family. However, I do have a few gripes about it.   Why oh why, can we not download Albums for offline viewing on mobile devices? Its silly that Google can pick out my dogs face out of thousands of pictures, but can't save an album to the device for offline viewing.  Speaking of picking my dog out of my pictures, I have had this app for years, and an account as well, and the People and Pets section is still only People. Please fix!  So far those are the only issues I can say about it.  So many good things though. Removing photos from the device after confirming they are on the cloud, in order to free up space on the device. Picking my dog out of thousands of photo's is very impressive, even if I have to search for animals instead my dogs name. And last but not least, the assistant, puts together nice collages, memory videos, and automatic albums based on location and time periods.  Well made, with many convenient features. However still lacking a few important ones.

Great app for storing your many pictures. It is great at organising your pictures. It also gives you a history of photos you took on a significant date years ago which is very nostalgic. It's a great app to use and you will enjoy having your photos stored here. If you lose your device all you have to do is remember your Google account and password and you'll have access to your pictures again.

Very Good Application. No matter what device I'm using I can always access my photos and videos without the use of a memory card. The downside is that in order to access some files on photos I would have to be connected to the internet. Another issue is not all files are automatically backed up and if you do not manually backup those files you run the risk of losing those files.

There is no option to delete a photo from the backup cloud instead of the device, I've been looking all around the internet and we have to play around with folders that we don't want backed up. I want a downloaded/ taken pic in on the default "camera" folder, but it gets backed up immediately, and it stays there even if the photo is moved to a non-backed up folder. Also, I believe there could easily be much more clarity of what we are doing, but the menus are bad instead. Make easier to control.

This app works great. However, there absolutely needs to be an option to NOT back up videos. I only want to back up my pictures. Videos take too much data in the cloud and, for me, take too long to upload. We don't all have gigabit speeds, specifically if we live in the country. Please add a toggle to disable video uploads. Amazon photos has that option and so should you. Thanks 😊

The new UI.. a hit and miss. It's more difficult (albeit inexistent) to see the auto generated creations, stylized photos etc, and specially movies and albuns: I miss the "for you" tab (you need to go to a PC). Good addition the map fixture... But still I can't edit date and geo tag my photos... Also I like the new edit features. for now it's more like a backup app with pay fixtures than a photo app.

Photos keep being automatically edited once they've been taken. In the preview, everything looks true to colour and texture, the moment I take a photo, it automatically processes, and everything looks much sharper and the colours are completely off. This never used to be the case so I don't know what kind of update caused this, but it's a horrible choice. Not happy. (Pre-emptively, I don't have any filters, editing, anything on. I've looked through editing and settings and nothing is helpful)

There are 2 issues: 1) when you delete a photo permanently from trash sometimes it comes back 2) when you free up space some of the photos can still be found locally, somehow it fails to delete them; however, I noticed that they are saved in cloud... I hope at least... Other than that, the app works pretty well now. Much better than it used to.

Couldn't help but need to comment for this time. The new update feels lacking the colors and the user friendliness that it used to have. Prefer the previous version over this newest update. Couldn't really find the share album, particularly the album that automatically shared by others that has certain people in the pictures. Still prefer the bigger thumbnail of the albums and more color-vibrant interface. The autogenerated highlight was not bad though.

Constant push notifications. Very needy app that constantly sends me notifications of pictures that have been backed up. No, I do not want a custom memory of the four work photos I took last Tuesday. Why do you think anyone wants this? Wish it would just quietly backup my photos as new phones have such limited internal storage. Not sure why I need to micro manage every apps push notification settings. It's becoming ridiculous.

there are many many bad qualities to this app but what I hated most was that it deleted 300 of my pictures to "free up space" and didn't give me the chance to choose which would be deleted. Of course I can still save back to my device but the quality of the picture isn't as great. Also the dates get messed up which makes the photo harder to find back as it wouldn't be in the same range as another photo that was taken on the same day.

I am giving one star because there is no room for zero star, bad experience , cant edit pictures. Immediately i click on a picture to edit, just after about 5seconds, it blacks out and i cannot do anything on the picture,left with only spotted dots as highlight..and very faint picture in background,tried every setting but no positive outcome.

Used to be a great app. Was a bit annoyed that google removed the automatic backup as an option a while ago, but usually remembered to open & back up every few days or so, but following the last update I have about 30 photos not backed up and it's stuck on 'Getting ready to back up' and saying I have nearly 4000 photos to back up? WTAF? It seems to think I have not backed up any photos... Ever... Despite them being visible when I actually look on my google account on the computer...

DO NOT USE. When you use this for back up and delete photos/videos from the app for more storage, it will also delete them from the device itself. Which isn't how backups are supposed to work. No one will buy more storage if they could delete unimportant photos first. UPDATE: I turned off back up and it still backs up my photos... so the solution I found is to remove access for the app and then do the sorting and stuff in Google Photos in the web. In the end, I really had to stop using the app.

Google photos does a great job of photo analysis. It can stitch together multiple photos to automatically create panoramic photos. It will make some "auto awesome" adjusts to some photos and ask if you like it to then save the new photo. Further to this, it will also automatically (usually) create an album if you travel and take photos. This is one of my favorite features. It usually chooses a subset of the best pictures and videos from your collection of photos taken while away and puts them all together in an album

I am really enjoying the app and I like the back up system. Fast and easy. I was able to save so many memories and be able to access them from any device. I am a little bit sad, since unlimited backup stopped and it's unnecessarily expensive. I would like to suggest that maybe you could give 15GB every year for free instead of unlimited. Either way I want to thank you for the app

Easy to organize photos in different albums. I really like the Locked Folder option to hide some photos. Limited editing, but I do not do much editing so it is perfect for me. I prefer this program to the Gallery program preinstalled on my phone. There are fun things to do such as animations and videos. Links right to an option to make photo books and so on. Any "glitches" or such have been minimal for me and I have been able to figure them out myself. Thank you!

Can't believe a software giant like Google is unable to make a good galley app. I admit that recent updates are making it faster but now it's a visual mess. It's showing all the useless folder that I don't want in my gallery such as video cache, app icons, empty file folders and there is no option to hide or ignore them. If any developer ever pays attention to the users then plz look into it.

Dreadful new set up. Can't find anything very easily & found it extremely difficult to create a new album. You've only got 2 stars cos you're known to be reliable with storing photos - & at least it found a load of empty folders that I was able to delete. However, apart from that, I don't really have anything good to say about it. Edit from 2 years ago. Can no longer use the app to edit new albums, & now have to go to the website to edit them.

Excellent app! I love how it creates animations, videos and collections on its own. I did a home project recently over the span of a couple weeks taking periodic pictures of the progress. A few days after the project was completed, I received a slideshow which pulled out only the pictures of the project. Awesome feature! It also creates then & now pictures if my kids and pulls together albums like "best of summer 2018" which are typically the pictures I would have chosen to pull into an album as well. To get a printed photo album out of the app is also possible, but pretty expensive. Overall, one of my favorite apps... although recently the automatic assistant creations have slowed in their frequency. Hopefully this feature improves as I do look forward to seeing what the app pulls together. It's both amazing and a little creepy at how well it does.

i have been using the app for years now, but a few weeks ago i got hit with the "unable to save changes" error, which makes editing photos or videos on my phone (OnePlus 7T) impossible. Uninstall/clear cache/clear storage/save to a different folder doesn't solve the issue. dear developpers, please fix this, there are a lot of people with this error on their devices already.

It is good and fast. . But I don't like the editing after the last update. The old editing was more intuitive and easy, please bring it back. . Another problem is that when creating a collage you can't arrange the photos the way you want, and I can't see why. . A suggestion: ad the option to add text to picture, so we don't need other editing apps.

11sept, update. Still can't handle a set of burst images properly. Now I have a phone that can capture burst sets of images, I have to mark this down again. Google photos handling of a set of burst images is pants. A set of 65 images and I have the option to keep one image lol. Google if you are interested. You need to be able to swipe through a set of images easily, select the ones that you want to keep and save. Not much to ask but you currently can't do anything like that.

I have been using this app for years and have historically been quite impressed with it BUT lately the amount of bugs is INCREASING at an alarming rate. I'm surprised with the lack of testing Google is allowing. Simple photo edits are not taking effect. They appear to at first, but later they are ignored and reverted back to the original photo. Very frustrating! Also, when I upload a photo from another device, then choose to save the photo to my mobile device in the app, it duplicates the photo! Why?? It's the same photo! Finally, why can't I edit the photo info (like dates) on the mobile app but I can on the desktop version??

I really enjoyed using Google Photos, until the backup feature got stuck, with an endless loop of "Getting ready to back up". There's not a lot of information on what to do when this happens - I've tried force stopping the app, clearing the cache and clearing the data - it only made the problem worse with 1 photo stuck now being 62 photos stuck. For those who aren't technologically literate, this issue would be a nightmare to fix, and would break the back up feature. You would think for an app that you pay for (to buy storage), things would be better.

Great photo storage, managing, editing, viewing and sharing app. Only one thing could make it better... the ability to show only photos that you haven't added to your albums - so you can see which ones still don't have a 'home' - either as a fixed feature, or one that can be toggled on or off. This way, you'll know which photos have not been 'categorised'.

Free unlimited storage of high quality photos is a great thing in itself, but it's so much more. The auto creation of animations, panorama's, stylised photos etc. is fun, as well as being transported back to good old memories with 'Remember This Day'. It's also a reliable and simple way to create a shared album where everyone can put their photos from a particular event in the same place for all to enjoy!

It"s brilliant. The more you find out about it, the better it gets. Except for the lack of ability to sort Albums by anything other than date. Why on earth can't each photo be moved up or down the list, so you can arrange them exactly how you want them. This facility exists widely in other applications, why not in Google photos. Marking down a star because of this.

The positive, SD cards can & do fail so irreplaceable media like photos are always backed up. The negative. It wants access to my SD card when I try to delete photos that are backed up in the cloud, there are photos I have no need to back up, that go into a separate folder on my phone. The app gives me an option to only save from certain folders, but I can't be sure if I allow access it won't 'find' that folder, & delete from it. I'd prefer to have the option of deleting from the cloud only.

Major problem with zoom. After viewing photo with zoom it is highly likely to hang. The bug quite easily reproduced, just open photo zoom in, then zoom out, then go to next photo and repeat. I'm not able to watch 10 photos this way and I need to close the program and reopen it. As result, the process of cleaning photos is a nightmare. Please make it easier and faster. Please also do some speed optimization for adding a photo to an album.A very nice to have feature: a list of albums photo belongs

I use Photos on a daily basis and see myself using it as long as I'm taking pictures, which will be the rest of my life. There are so many options that I still haven't used it to it's full potential. I love how it identifies by people's faces, searches for them if you need, even creates memory books with the option to order a printed hard cover copy (paid, of course), allows you to free up space on your phone by deleting originals. I pay willingly for storage for that option.

I love the surprises from the photo assistant -memories, special effects, collages and more! And the automatic upload. I didn't give 5 stars because: although the search usually gives adequate results, it sometimes yields nothing on a keyword that should be simple enough (or totally wrong results) , and albums are difficult to search. I would like to be able to handle my albums, and see them, as easily add I did in Picasa. For example, I had to create 4 albums with the same name, because when I w

This app... Let's say that I had a lot of problems while using this app. Firstly, I couldn't edit pictures due to a certain error; secondly, whenever I moved my photos to my new album, it didn't show up as if the app didn't know that these images were in the said album; lastly, the compression after I trimmed the video was definitely unnecessary. With this in mind, I hope you guys will take action against these problems.

It is not okay to force-update my phone to Android 16, where I am certain someone had to know that it is not going to work on the Pixel 6. Crashing. Overheating. if you can name it then I have experienced it. It is basically a way to try to get people to spend money and get a new phone. I think that's a pretty poor way of doing business.
This app saved my life, it's really amazing and useful, make sure you install it. 👍

The almost perfect mobile app for photography. What I still missing are the followings: 1) making local adjustments with a brush (darken, lighten a particular area of the photograph) 2) if I edit a photo book, it would be nice to be able to edit an inserted photograph (sometimes some more adjustments are needed because photos on the same place have different color temperatures or lightness) 3) perspective correction tool would be useful 4) giving more stars to photos than only one would be great.

A very good way to manage ALL your photos from anywhere on any device. I tell my friends about it because its so delightful being able to browse my entire collection of photos on my phone. Its cool to skim through old photos and go back in time anywhere. Google photos is the solution to digital photo chaos. *edit. Deleting photos from the sd card - currently not working for me. *Edit. Suddenly not as useful as a gallery app when you cannot integrate it with other cloud storage options.

They've ruined the quick photo editing ability I loved so much. Instead of being able to adjust the settings and play around with them together to get the look I want, I now have to click into each one, adjust it, then come back out, then adjust the next one and so on. It also takes a while to load the editing controls, whereas before it was almost instant. This is such a massive step backwards. Not at all usable and will be looking for a new photo app.

Can't switch off video autoplay; whoever thought this was a good idea? That person should be sacked. Yes, you can disable it in the grid view, but try scrolling through your photos in a quiet place and next thing it blares out at top volume. Woke my partner up the other night as I was trying to post stuff onto social media. Taking these basics of control away from users is a sure way to drive them away. I'm off, and downloading an alternative. Used to like it. No longer.

Generally a good app to edit and organize your photos. Would have given it five stars, if it wasn't for the occasional freeze/crash every now and then. Observed this behavior acrose at least three different phones (pixel 4, 5 and 8 pro). On the plus side it's completely ad-free and there's only a single version that includes all the features, although some of the more advanced stuff seems to be available only on the latest Google Pixel phones for a while (eg magic eraser).

UGH! The only reason I used this app was the sharing option. But for some reason, in the last few months, it won't let me see albums shared with me at all. It's full of bugs, searching is a nightmare, adding already uploaded photos to albums takes forever and I have to add a few at a time to make sure it doesn't miss any of my photos or videos. Super time consuming, frustrating and just an awful customer experience. Honestly, guys, you're freaking Google for crying out loud. Make an effort!!

Why is there weird music over MY videos? Why does is slowly zoom in or out on MY pictures. I like the concept of remembering these times, but please stop adding features over my memories. Please just make it an option in my settings to turn your added features off. Thanks. Update 5/14/23: I am still absolutely disappointed with the memories feature. 3 years later and still not any better. 4/20/26 Stop cropping my memory pics. I wish I could detach everything I have from Google.

I keep finding more and more annoying bugs update (25/03/19) downgrading from 3 to 2*. Impossible to delete more than one photo without having to go back into the main library and reselecting the next photo. Also, why the hell would i want to edit a photo and save as copy and have 100000 copies of the same photo!? just want to edit the existing one, is it really that hard to achieve?

Love it! It's easy to use, quite self explanatory. I do enjoy using the eraser function but it won't work in some situation and you are left with a blob. The enhancement options are sufficient and you can use DIY option, although I would like to alway decide whether to save as a copy or just save/update photo. Rarely use collage as the is no much option to manually change it. Overall great with some space for improvement.

From great to average. The storage is good. The editing is average, useless at most. The most annoying thing is the app keeps showing my local pix from my phone. STOP IT! I just want to browse what I uploaded. Damn. Also I cannot choose which folder to put my pictures in. I'm a photographer and I want to separate my personal from client or scouting or ideas pix.

Quietly backing up photos while charging phone. I like it. Edit: New version is much more complicated and less intuitive. I used to enjoy getting memories from years ago and being able to share. Now they're useless. Albums are gone. I will never use the slideshow. My family can no longer take part. I want my easily sharable collages please!
It should not be very hard to implement to sort photos by EXIF date and by creation date (cdate) when not available. It's very annoying that photos aren't sorted in a decent fashion.

What happened to select all, I have to manually select hundreds of photos? And if I want to download a photo, it's a multi step process on top of that. I'm definitely ending my increased storage storage subscription, and finding a more versatile photo storage provider that lets me manage my files easily. Most recent updates address storage, of which I have more than sufficient space. What I don't have is time to waste organising all my images individually. Fix that.

tired of AI making decisions for me. won't let u see your screenshot. if I took them they're there for a reason I pay for extra storage and then you're telling me that I won't have any more space. I'm receiving a weird text talking about pay for more storage I don't know what's real and not real anymore why can't I just go into the app and pay for my extra storage. hey I sucks if you can't think for yourself I don't want any machine to think for me show me my pictures and will decide what delete

I love saving my photos on Google photos. I have paid a subscription for it and I am glad that I have. A few suggestions: 1. I wish it could suggest duplicate photos so that we can delete those. 2. Also, I would like to be able to filter irrelevant data from my photos e.g. memes and e cards for various occasions so that I could delete those as well. Overall, though, definitely worth the purchase.

Wrote my first review for Photos a long time ago, it's changed a lot since then, generally getting better and cleverer. I like the search, I'd expect Google to be good at that. I do see some comments I add getting confused and added to other photos, and manually editing face/names is sometimes hit and miss. Overall I think my photos are well looked after and easy to access.

Simple to use, with some areas of improvement. When streaming on Chrome cast, mainly with video, after a couple of minutes it disconnects. It might be a thing from the device's side, but still it shouldn't happen. Also, I don't like that it defaults to DCME, backing up Screenshots. I only want to backup camera pictures, not screen shots. Other than that, it automatically backs up pics, so one doesn't have to worry, and the free-up space feature is great.

Backing up photos are taking so much time, and I cant distinguish if the photos are already backed up. I wish at least there's a mark saying that the photos or videos are already backed up. Other than that its good, amazing, helpful, and reliable. It can do a lot of things like editing pictures, making collage, animation, etc. automatically! I'll give this 5 star coz i know that there's no perfect app.

It's great for storing, viewing, and editing photos (adjusting balance and cropping and so on). But text annotation features, like "Add description" to a photo, or adding text boxes to an album, are much too buggy and by no means up to Google's usual standards. After adding a description to a photo, the description often disappears within a few seconds. Adding a text box in an album frequently causes the app to crash, with the loss of your text. Summary: good, but not good enough in some ways.

Good experience overall, but some things are very cumbersome. You can't delete photos from an album, if you find something in an album you want to delete you have to scroll through and find it in your full library of backed up photos. The app would also benefit from an offline mode where only your photos downloaded to your device are shown (like a gallery setting), then people who don't have a ton of data can have an enjoyable experience, rather than scrolling through hundreds of blank photos.

This is more than just a way to view your photos. It will organise them for you as well, which sometimes is a bit OTT. But, having said that it has some nice features, like it will identify the people in your photo so you can ask it to show you photos with that person in..... Getting a bit 'Minority Report'?! Or photos of one particular place.

I love this app! Aside from saving everything for me and creating animations, stylized pics and videos, it also will suggest photos of paperwork, screenshots, etc. to send to the archive and free up space. It's very intuitive, and I love that I can go back by date to look for particular photos. On more than one occasion it's helped me out when I've needed a photo that I've already downloaded into my home computer and deleted off my phone. Highly recommend!

Could be perfect, isn't. It's excellent for backing up photos but there are some serious kinks that could be easily solved but haven't been. I don't care about automatically stylised photos (which are usually rubbish) but the panorama feature is great. Animations and movies are hit and miss. The fact that it insists on deleting photos off your devices if you delete them from the app, even if you don't want to, is a pain. Also the ordering of photos that have correct dates/times is horrendous

The dates of when the pictures were taken are not accurate. When you want to access to the photos through another app, you can't browse by album making it pretty hard to go through 100's of pictures till you get to the one you need when you could have just gone to the album you had already created and easily find what you are looking for. Other than that I like the somewhat accurate Memories feature!

Awesome app! It was super easy to use, and had so many useful features, a must have app for everyone! It's so convenient too; you can do the basics like storing and organizing pictures and videos in folders, and you can also back them up, you can crop and edit the photos or videos, you can search and scan for texts in a picture, you can search the picture from the app to Google, and it makes sharing and using the photos and videos on another device much easier.

This review is for Android app. Backup and getting photos after freeing space stuck. I'm having this kind of issues periodically since more than a year. Having read all the articles, forums, tried all the suggested steps, and sometimes it works at the end for no apparent reason. Now it seems to be working after uninstalling updates and waiting for a few hours. A few days ago it accumulated until 900 photos waiting to be backed up. They were finally backed up using mobile data. It seems to work very randomly.

If there is anything good at all that I can say about this app, it's that it at least lets me keep all files in one place and it neatly segregates my files into folders according to how the filed were obtained - there is a screenshot folder, a camera folder and a folder for almost every editing app. That's great, however there are many things about this app that could be improved. First of all, why is it that I can't create folders simply how I want? Why can't this storage app be like the 'Computer' icon in Windows, where it actually allows you to create folders, rename folders, delete folders, make folders within folders and move files however and wherever you want? Also, there is an issue with deleting files - it takes something like 5 minutes to delete 60MB of data. Why, may I ask?

Very good app for storing and organising photos. However, the face recognition thing is a bit hit and miss. Also, it would be nice to be able to group albums together in collections, and the ability to rearrange albums into an order of my own choosing would be nice. Maybe the ability to add a discription to the album would also be nice. But there are some great features, such as the auto animations and movies.

I love the app. It's generally easy to use and has good features. However, ot would be great if there is a way to filter the pictures in the all photos tab. For example to be able to see only photos that are not in any album which can make it much easier to delete the extra photos we don't need. Also, the video creator has so many glitches. For example, when inserting a video in it, sometimes it doesn't play it properly. It often takes so long time for the video to be finalized.

Tried to do the backup and free up space process that it recommended, but then I could only see the removed photos through a browser under 'recently added' and not in the app. It took so long to discover where my photos went that I had an anxiety attack. Downloading the photos back messed with the quality of them and I had to download one at a time because all at once makes a zip folder that my gallery couldn't access. Think I'm going to stick with my running out of space icon as that doesn't cause nearly as much stress.

its pretty okay. My biggest concern is when I try to arrange photos in my albums in the order I want them, it only works sometimes. This is very frustrating! please fix this. I would also like to arrange the albums themselves my own way. EDIT: I noticed you can alphabetize the albums, not sure if this is new, or I missed it before, but I like this.

Perfect. Still have pictures from when I was a kid, and the only issue I've had is with the backup; you have to go on the app for it to back up, rather than it doing it in the background but thats just a nitpick. The image search works really well, too. You also have to pay monthly for storage and in their defense it isnt much, but id still just rather buy it as a one-time payment. As a result, I've never bought any extra storage. That's what gets it 4 stars. Otherwise, perfect

This app is very useful, as it not only stores your photos (as you would expect) but it also allows you to categorise for certain things (eg. ducks) and to filter for certain places (eg. taken in Dublin). It also prompts you if you have photos that are taking up space that aren't very good, e.g. blurry photos, or screenshots of videogames. Also, there are of course no ads or in-app purchases. However, there is one problem with the UI, in that it shows photos at different sizes on the screen.

Has great features (like face detection, sync, sharing, among others) but I think it could be better. The way it shows the folders isn't that easy to navigate and as it opens, the main tab "photos" only shows the camera's photo when in fact I'd really like to go directly to the folders, eg: downloads, WhatsApp photos, videos, VSCO, whatever.

I like the app, but I have a problem. The descriptions of the photos are not good all the time. They used to get mix up. When I scroll down each picture to make a description and I directly go to the next picture because of the same to do, after some descriptions they do not fit exactly when I finished.
